package.name: racer_perception
package.description: Roadmap 5.1, camera perception (OPTIONAL, outside the thesis; docs/notes/perception-2026-10-23.md). detector_node runs a YOLO detector (ultralytics, PyTorch: only in a car image built with INSTALL_PERCEPTION=required) on a CompressedImage topic and publishes vision_msgs/Detection2DArray. fusion_node fuses the detections with the LiDAR scan into racer_msgs/ObjectDetectionArray (vehicle-frame bearing, robust range) and publishes the nearest person as /perception/target. The maths (racer_perception/fusion.py, person_tracker.py, throttle.py) are pure Python and L1-tested without ROS. Nothing here publishes to the command path.
